verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a built-in Arcade Physics system providing velocity, acceleration, gravity, and collision handling out of the box, and community testimony (phaser-comm-13) lists physics as a core built-in feature, but the pack explicitly notes Arcade physics 'does have its limitations' (phaser-docs-24) and never mentions raycasting or full rigid-body dynamics (e.g., Matter.js integration) with concrete examples. Missing for 10: explicit raycast API evidence, rigid-body/Matter physics documentation, and independent confirmation of collision accuracy beyond Arcade's simplified AABB model.
